programs.name: Computer Science
programs.description: Wrocław's premier technical CS program. Software engineering, AI, cybersecurity, and data science. Faculty of Electronics. Strong ties to IT sector in Lower Silesia.

programs.name: Artificial Intelligence
programs.description: Machine learning, deep learning, and data science. Research-focused with modern AI labs. Growing tech community in Wrocław.

programs.name: Mechanical Engineering
programs.description: Automotive engineering, design, and production technology. Faculty of Mechanical Engineering. Strong in industrial design and modern manufacturing.

programs.name: Civil Engineering
programs.description: Structural engineering and infrastructure design. Sustainable construction focus with modern labs. Wrocław infrastructure investments provide practical training opportunities.

programs.name: Electrical Engineering
programs.description: Power systems, electronics, and telecommunications. Faculty of Electrical Engineering. Combines theory with practical lab work.

programs.name: Cybernetics
programs.description: Control systems, robotics, and automation. Modern labs for embedded systems and Industry 4.0. Research-oriented with industry collaboration.
